**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor of Science in computer science or related quantitative field
* 8+ years of experience with software engineering and software development life cycle
* 5+ years of experience designing, developing, and supporting Spring Boot-based APIs and backend services
* Hands-on experience in backend software engineering within large-scale enterprise environments
* Experience with React to build modern, responsive, and accessible user interfaces(Good to have)
* Experience with one of the cloud platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP)
* Experience working in Agile software development environments, collaborating closely with product, engineering, and operations teams
* Experience working with relational databases, including MS SQL
* Experience supporting systems in regulated environments with a solid focus on reliability, security, and compliance, particularly within healthcare or pharmacy domains
* Working knowledge of CI/CD practices and tooling, including GitHub Actions, artifact management, secrets management, and automated quality controls
* Solid proficiency in Java, with demonstrated experience building secure, scalable, and maintainable applications

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Azure cloud experience
* Experience with Optum enterprise platforms and tooling, including Skyline
* Experience with Camunda or similar workflow and business process orchestration frameworks
* Experience supporting high-availability, customer-facing platforms in healthcare, pharmacy benefit management, or related regulated industries
* Familiarity with operational excellence practices, including observability, incident management, and production support for mission-critical systems

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. description:
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365 - all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from the world’s top investors - including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock, GIC, Elad Gil and Goldman Sachs—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
**About The Role**
Rippling is building core AI Platform infrastructure that will power intelligent and automated experiences across the company. This includes background agents, automated workflows, evaluation systems, data pipelines, model-quality loops, sandboxing, scaling, latency, reliability, and platform primitives that other product teams can build on.
  
  
As a
****Staff Software Engineer****
, you will operate as a hands-on technical leader. You will own ambiguous platform problems, lead cross-functional initiatives, shape architecture, and continue to write/review/debug production code. This role is not for someone who wants to only advise or delegate.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own major AI Platform initiatives across backend, platform, infrastructure, and AI-enabled systems.
* Lead design and execution for systems supporting agents, evals, automation, data pipelines, model quality, sandboxing, scaling, latency, and reliability.
* Act as a technical lead for cross-functional work involving Product, Infra, Platform, AI, and Engineering teams.
* Break down ambiguous technical problems into clear architecture and execution plans.
* Write code, review critical code paths, debug production issues, and make implementation-level decisions.
* Build platform systems that can be reused by multiple product teams across Rippling.
* Raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and technical guidance.
* Balance speed, quality, reliability, and long-term platform maintainability.

**Qualifications**

* 10–15 years of software engineering experience, preferably in backend, platform, infrastructure, distributed systems, AI platform, or product engineering.
* Strong hands-on coding ability; must be willing to remain close to code, debugging, design reviews, and implementation details.
* Strong programming knowledge in one or more languages such as Python, Java, Go/Golang, C++, Scala, Kotlin, or C#.
* Proven experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems in production.
* Experience in high-growth or hyper-growth startup/product environments is strongly preferred.
* Strong system design and architecture fundamentals across APIs, databases, data modeling, concurrency, reliability, observability, and production operations.
* Ability to lead ambiguous, cross-functional technical initiatives without formal authority.
* Strong product intuition and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business impact.
* Ability to mentor engineers and raise the technical bar while continuing to code.
* Practical exposure or strong curiosity around AI agents, LLM infrastructure, agentic workflows, ML/data infrastructure, inference pipelines, evals, fine-tuning, post-training, or automation systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Recent hands-on experience building AI agents, LLM tooling, AI infrastructure, automation platforms, eval systems, or model-quality systems.
* Experience with workflow orchestration, background automation, self-healing systems, reliability platforms, or internal developer platforms.
* Experience with permissions, approvals, auditability, compliance, security-sensitive workflows, or enterprise-grade controls.
* Strong Python and SQL knowledge.
* Experience with Go, Java, C++, or Scala in platform, infrastructure, distributed systems, or large-scale backend environments.
* Experience in AI-native, cloud/infra, platform-heavy, enterprise SaaS, fintech, HR tech, payroll, benefits, compliance, IT, or workflow-heavy companies.

You're ready to gain the skills and experience needed to grow within your role and advance your career — and we have the perfect software engineering opportunity for you.
  
  
As a Software Engineer II at JPMorganChase within the Commercial & Investment Bank- Payments Technology team, you are part of an agile team that works to enhance, design, and deliver the software components of the firm's state-of-the-art technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. * Executes standard software solution, design, development, and technical troubleshooting
* Writes secure and high-quality code using the syntax of at least one programming language with limited guidance
* Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards.
* Designs, develops, codes, and troubleshoots with consideration of upstream and downstream systems and technical implications
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation
* Applies technical troubleshooting to breakdown solutions and solve technical problems of basic complexity
* Gathers, analyzes, and draws conclusions from large, diverse data sets to identify problems and contribute to decision-making in service of secure, stable application development
* Learns and applies system processes, methodologies, and skills for the development of secure, stable code and systems

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 2+ years applied experience ( NAMR/APAC – India/ LATAM/ Hong Kong)
* Hands-on practical experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
* Experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment with one or more modern programming languages and database querying languages
* Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, testing, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations.
* Experience across the whole Software Development Life Cycle
* Exposure to agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Full stack Java developer experience in enterprise application development
* Strong experience in SDLC delivery in Agile methodologies
* At least two years experience in Java 17+
* Experience developing microservices, packaged into AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service and/or Elastic Container Service, and deployed to EC2 instances
* Experience writing Terraform scripts and deploying in AWS production environment
* Experience in at least one relational database management system (preferably Oracle or PostgreSQL)

* Strong programming skills in C++ and Python.

* Understanding of compiler fundamentals, including intermediate representations, dataflow analysis, and code generation.

* Experience with FP16, BF16, FP8, or low-bit quantization and their accuracy and performance tradeoffs.

title: Principal Security Engineer, AI Governance
description:
**What You Can Expect**
As a Senior Security Engineer on Zoom's Enterprise Security team, you will own the AI Governance program end to end, defining the technical standards and risk posture that determine how Zoom adopts AI safely and at scale. On any given day, you will be assessing emerging AI use cases, building security frameworks for GenAI and agentic systems, and serving as the trusted technical voice on AI security for engineering and enterprise stakeholders across four critical domains. This is a hands-on, highly autonomous role that calls for real depth in both AI/ML systems and security engineering; candidates without working familiarity with how modern AI introduces security risk will not be set up for success here. You will work as part of a globally distributed, multi-domain security engineering team, collaborating closely with colleagues across time zones and contributing across adjacent security domains beyond AI.
  
  
**About The Team**
Zoom's Enterprise Security team is the engineering foundation behind how the company identifies, contains, and gets ahead of risk across its most critical systems. Working across AI, data, network, endpoint, and cloud security, the team builds the controls, standards, and architectures that let Zoom move quickly without creating unacceptable exposure. As Zoom deepens its investment in AI across Zoom Workplace and its broader platform, this team's work is increasingly central to how the company grows responsibly.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the AI governance risk register and end-to-end assessment methodology across four domains (GenAI, Agentic AI, Shadow AI/Local AI, and AI Gateway/MCP); conduct and review risk evaluations using Likelihood x Impact scoring and drive remediation with owning engineering teams.
* Identify and prioritize security gaps in GenAI deployments including prompt injection, data leakage, model misuse, and insecure output handling; define monitoring and guardrail requirements for agentic systems operating with significant autonomy and tool access.
* Lead the Shadow AI governance strategy end to end, from quantifying risk exposure to recommending and operationalizing detection and enforcement controls across the enterprise.
* Set the security bar for AI gateway and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations, including secure configuration, access control frameworks, and governance coverage.
* Architect reference security patterns for AI adoption (AI gateways, MCP servers, agent frameworks, LLM integrations) and serve as design authority in AI-related architecture reviews; translate the AI Governance Risk Charter into a concrete roadmap of technical requirements and measurable outcomes.
* Drive evaluations of AI security tooling (AI gateways, CASB/SWG, agentic monitoring, MCP governance solutions), including POC design, cost-benefit analysis, and leadership recommendations; author and maintain security standards and policy for AI adoption.
* Lead security architecture reviews and risk assessments across adjacent domains including Network, Endpoint, Cloud, and Data Security; contribute to incident response, detection engineering, and purple team exercises as shared team functions.
* Serve as the primary technical partner to AI/ML, engineering, and enterprise teams; lead cross-functional working groups, mentor engineers on risk analysis and documentation quality, and deliver clear reporting on AI risk posture and forecasted challenges to leadership.

**What We're Looking For**

* 10+ years of security engineering or cybersecurity experience, including end-to-end ownership of a security domain or program, with a track record of driving risk assessment, prioritization, and remediation across cross-functional teams.
* Solid working knowledge of modern AI/ML systems and the security risks they introduce (LLMs, generative AI, agentic systems); direct experience securing GenAI or LLM-based applications in an enterprise environment is a strong differentiator.
* Understanding of AI gateways, Model Context Protocol (MCP), CASB/SWG, or DLP tooling, and a working understanding of shadow AI detection and governance strategies.
* Working knowledge across core security domains (network, endpoint, cloud, and data security) sufficient to independently lead architecture reviews and risk assessments outside of AI.
* Experience designing security reference architectures or serving as a design authority in complex, cross-functional technical environments; threat modeling experience applied to AI or novel technology stacks is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, communicate risk clearly in writing and verbally, and drive alignment across engineering, product, and enterprise teams without direct authority.
* Comfort operating in a globally distributed team with regular overlap with US Pacific hours; ability to work with high autonomy and produce clear, actionable risk documentation for leadership audiences.

**Ways of Working**
Our structured hybrid approach is centered around our offices and remote work environments. The work style of each role, Hybrid, Remote, or In-Person is indicated in the job description/posting.
  
  
**Benefits**
As part of our award-winning workplace culture and commitment to delivering happiness, our benefits program offers a variety of perks, benefits, and options to help employees maintain their physical, mental, emotional, and financial health; support work-life balance; and contribute to their community in meaningful ways. Click Learn for more information.
  
  
**About Us**
Zoomies help people stay connected so they can get more done together. We set out to build the best collaboration platform for the enterprise, and today help people communicate better with products like Zoom Contact Center, Zoom Phone, Zoom Events, Zoom Apps, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom Webinars.
  
  
We’re problem-solvers, working at a fast pace to design solutions with our customers and users in mind. Find room to grow with opportunities to stretch your skills and advance your career in a collaborative, growth-focused environment.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
At Zoom, we believe great work happens when people feel supported and empowered. We’re committed to fair hiring practices that ensure every candidate is evaluated based on skills, experience, and potential. If you require an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know—we’re here to support you at every step.

The
**Equities Technology**
division is responsible for building and maintaining the high-performance, ultra-low-latency trading infrastructure that powers our global equities business. This includes market data dissemination, order routing, algorithmic execution, smart order routing (SOR), and real-time risk management systems. We operate in a highly competitive environment where microseconds matter, requiring cutting-edge software engineering practices, deep hardware-software co-design, and robust system reliability.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an exceptional
**Senior Software Engineer**
with deep expertise in
**Rust**
and
**C++**
to join our Equities Low-Latency Trading Technology team.
  
  
In this role, you will design, develop, and optimize our next-generation trading systems. You will lead the strategic transition of legacy high-performance C++ components to modern Rust where safety and concurrency are paramount, while continuing to maintain and optimize critical ultra-low-latency C++ execution paths. This is a highly technical role requiring a strong understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, network protocols, and modern software engineering paradigms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Skills**
**8+ YOE is a must have**

* System Design & Development
* Architect, build, and maintain ultra-low-latency trading systems, including exchange connectivity gateways, market data feeds, and algorithmic execution engines using Rust and C++
* Design clean, modular, and reusable APIs and libraries that can be leveraged across multiple trading desks.
* Lead the strategic migration of critical trading components from C++ to Rust, leveraging Rust's memory safety and concurrency guarantees without sacrificing performance.
* Performance Optimization
* Profile and optimize systems to achieve sub-microsecond latencies and deterministic performance.
* Apply low-latency techniques such as CPU pinning, cache-friendly data structures, lock-free programming, memory-mapped files, and custom memory allocators.
* Utilize kernel bypass technologies (e.g., Solarflare OpenOnload, DPDK, EF\\_VI) to minimize network stack overhead.
* Concurrency & Reliability
* Design and implement highly concurrent, thread-safe, and lock-free algorithms to handle massive throughput with minimal jitter.
* Implement rigorous testing methodologies, including unit testing, integration testing, property-based testing (in Rust), and high-fidelity simulation/back testing environments.
* Ensure the high availability and operational resilience of trading systems through robust error handling and failover mechanisms.
* Collaboration & Support
* Work closely with quantitative researchers, traders, and product managers to translate complex trading strategies and business requirements into robust, production-ready software.
* Build real-time telemetry, monitoring, and alerting tools to ensure operational visibility.
* Provide level-3 escalation support for production systems during market hours.

**Required Technical Skills & Qualifications**
**Programming Languages**

* C++: Expert-level proficiency in C++ (C++11/14/17/20), with a deep understanding of template metaprogramming, RAII, move semantics, smart pointers, and the standard library (STL).
* Rust: Strong proficiency in Rust, including ownership/borrowing concepts, lifetimes, unsafe Rust boundaries, macro systems, and the Cargo ecosystem.

**Systems Programming & Low-Latency**

* Deep understanding of Linux operating system internals (kernel tuning, memory management, virtual memory, page faults, system calls).
* Experience with low-latency networking (TCP/IP, UDP, Multicast) and socket programming.
* Familiarity with hardware-level concepts: CPU cache hierarchies (L1/L2/L3), TLB, branch prediction, and memory barriers.

**Concurrency**

* Proven experience in multi-threaded programming, memory models (sequential consistency, acquire-release), and lock-free data structures.

**Equities Domain Knowledge**

* Solid understanding of Equities market structure, order types, exchange protocols (FIX, OUCH, ITCH), and trading lifecycles.

**Tools & Infrastructure**

* Experience with profiling and debugging tools (gdb, valgrind, perf, VTune, heaptrack).
* Proficiency with build systems (CMake, Cargo) and CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins/GitHub Actions).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with FPGA integration or hardware acceleration.
* Experience with kernel bypass technologies (Solarflare EF\\_VI, OpenOnload, DPDK).
* Knowledge of market-making, smart order routing (SOR), or statistical arbitrage execution strategies.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

* Collaboration: Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional team environment.
* Adaptability: Eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving business requirements and market conditions.

In this hands-on engineering role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end coding, implementation, optimization, and maintenance of high-throughput, mission-critical financial calculation engines and distributed microservices supporting global institutional hedge fund clients. This platform processes complex, tiered fee structures and high-volume transactional workflows across multiple business lines, demanding ultra-low latency, strict transactional integrity (ACID), high availability, and clean, resilient code design.
  
  
As a Senior Developer, your primary focus will be active coding, system design, query optimization, automated testing, and CI/CD deployment. You will work closely with lead architects, product analysts, and engineering peers to build robust full-stack solutions, debug complex issues, refactor legacy components, and champion software craftsmanship across modern Java and Angular frameworks.

* API & System Integration: Design, develop, and consume secure, robust RESTful APIs and asynchronous event-driven messaging pipelines (Kafka / RabbitMQ / JMS).
* Refactoring & Modernization: Actively contribute to legacy code modernization, containerization (Docker, OpenShift / Kubernetes), and framework upgrades to maintain modern architectural standards.
* Debugging & Problem Solving: Deep-dive into complex runtime issues, thread contention, memory leaks, and distributed transaction bottlenecks to deliver rapid, permanent technical fixes.

* Production Support & L3 Troubleshooting: Partner with SRE and DevOps teams to triage Level 3 production issues, analyze logs and metrics (Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus), and implement permanent root-cause fixes.

* Secure Coding: Follow secure development lifecycle (SDLC) standards, remediate security vulnerabilities (SAST/DAST findings), and ensure data encryption/privacy protocols are rigorously maintained.
* Audit & Control Governance: Ensure all deliverables adhere to Citi's software engineering governance, change management protocols, and risk controls.

* Experience: 6–10+ years of hands-on software development experience building enterprise-scale distributed systems and transactional applications.

* Frontend Engineering: Hands-on experience developing single-page applications (SPAs) using modern Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, HTML5, and CSS/SCSS.
* Relational Database Expertise: Strong hands-on SQL programming and tuning experience across MSSQL, Oracle, or PostgreSQL (complex joins, CTEs, indexing, query execution plans).
* Event Streaming & Messaging: Practical experience developing event-driven producers/consumers using Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, or JMS.
* Containerization & Tooling: Working knowledge of Docker, Red Hat OpenShift / Kubernetes, Linux shell scripting, and Git/Bitbucket.
* CI/CD & Testing Frameworks: Experience with Maven/Gradle, Jenkins, Harness, JUnit, Mockito, and SonarQube.

* Financial domain background in Hedge Fund Operations, Fund Administration, Institutional Billing, Asset Management, or Capital Markets.

* Kubernetes: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, including cluster management, application deployment (Helm charts), and monitoring.

title: Reactivate Your Career Program – Java Full stack Developer
description:
Citi   is delighted to open applications for the Application Development and Software Engineering stream of its Reactivate Your Career Program. The Program is designed to help you transition from a career break into a career within financial services. You may have worked in the finance sector, the tech sector or another industry altogether!
  
  
Returners in the Application Development and Software Engineering stream, will have the opportunity to utilize their knowledge of applications development procedures and concepts, and basic knowledge of other technical areas to identify and define necessary system enhancements, including using script tools and analyzing/interpreting code.
  
  
We are interested in applications from those who have a range of experience including, but not limited to:
  
  

* Experience: 4 years of proven software development experience, specializing in Java, JavaScript, Spring Boot, and Oracle.
* Full Stack Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to design, develop, and maintain both front-end and back-end components of robust web applications.
* Back-End Development: Solid experience in developing server-side logic and APIs using languages such as Java, Python, or similar.
* Database Expertise: Comprehensive knowledge of SQL and PL/SQL, with a deep understanding of Relational Database Management Systems (RDBMS), particularly Oracle.
* AI: Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and interest in leveraging AI to enhance productivity

We value your knowledge, skills and experience, regardless of how and where you have developed them. We believe that hiring people from different backgrounds with an array of perspectives brings advantages to our teams and ultimately makes Citi a better place to work.
  
  
This supportive hiring programme will start in September 2026 and you will benefit from a structured and in-depth induction to help you transition successfully back into the workplace, followed by a tailored programme of professional development and learning delivered over a period of 4 weeks.
  
  
You will enjoy the benefits of being part of a supportive cohort and will be paired with a buddy to assist with a smooth transition into life in Citi. Citi recognizes the importance of flexible working arrangements and is happy to explore these with you in line with local policy.  Citi operates a hybrid working model for the majority of roles across the bank.
  
  
  
  
**Eligible candidates will....**

* Have been on a career break for at least 18 months
* Have a minimum of 4 -5 years professional work experience in an Application Development / Software Engineering environment
* Be eligible to live and work in India
* Demonstrate natural curiosity and be motivated to learn new skills, with a proactive attitude toward new technologies and methodologies
* Exhibit excellent teamwork, able to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams
* Effective communicator with a problem solving mindset and exhibit accountability
* Possess working knowledge of English

  
  
To apply- Please answer four motivational questions below with a max of 200 words per question. Please add your responses to the bottom of your CV.
  
  

* What interests you about joining the Reactivate Your Career Program and why now?
* Why have you chosen to apply to Citi?
* What makes you interested in a technology role in Financial Services?
* What personal goals would you like to achieve during the course of the program?

We are seeking a highly experienced, technically proficient, and execution-focused

with

This role demands deep technical expertise in Python, distributed systems, and modern DevOps practices, combined with a strong background in quantitative computation and market risk domains.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader who can drive software engineering excellence, manage technical aspects of complex projects (including planning, governance, and budgeting), and collaborate effectively with globally matrixed teams, including Risk Managers, Risk Analytics, Senior Quants, and Front Office (FO) teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Architecture, Design & Hands-on Development
* Lead Implementation: Lead the hands-on implementation and architecture of robust Python frameworks to build horizontally scalable, highly available, highly resilient, and performant applications.
* Platform Engineering: Design and develop efficient software platforms for high-throughput data computation, processing, and quantitative calculations.
* Standards & Alignment: Develop solutions adhering to enterprise architectural standards, utilizing in-depth technical and business domain knowledge.
* Database & API Design: Design, develop, and secure high-performance RESTful APIs, integration patterns, and database schemas (relational and NoSQL).
* Technical Leadership, Governance & Delivery
* SDLC & Code Quality: Enforce industry-standard SDLC best practices and contribute to code quality through rigorous code reviews, automated testing, and continuous integration.
* Project Ownership: Take full ownership of technical initiatives, including planning, forecasting, project tracking, governance, and managing technology budgets at the team level.
* Change Management: Drive continuous improvement, change management, and modern software engineering practices within the development team.
* Independent Execution: Work independently, multi-task, and manage priorities effectively under pressure to meet tight deadlines or unexpected changes in requirements.
* Collaboration & Stakeholder Management
* Cross-Functional Partnership: Act as a key liaison and partner with Risk Managers, Risk Analytics, Senior Quants, Front Office (FO), DevOps, and Production Support teams to ensure seamless IT deliveries.
* Global Collaboration: Work effectively in a globally matrixed environment, partnering with virtual teams and external partners across different time zones.
* Executive Communication: Consistently demonstrate clear, concise, and impactful written and verbal communication, ranging from technical discussions within the team to presentations for senior business executives.

**Required Technical Qualifications**
I. Core Python, DSA & System Development
  
  

* Experience: 12+ years of hands-on application development experience, with a primary focus on Python, Data Structures and Algorithms.
* Python Expertise: Expert-level Python 3.x proficiency, with deep knowledge of core concepts, advanced computation libraries, and design patterns (OOP, SOLID).
* Frameworks: Advanced knowledge of Python web and API frameworks (FastAPI, Django, Flask).
* Distributed Systems: Strong understanding of software architecture principles and distributed system design (Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, caching strategies).
* Database Systems: Extensive experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis), including advanced SQL query writing and optimization.
* Operating Systems: Highly experienced with Unix/Linux-based operating systems, shell scripting, and system-level development.

II. Cloud, DevOps & Testing
  
  

* Cloud Platforms: Strong background in cloud platforms AWS or IBM symphony grid.
* Containerization & Orchestration: Hands-on experience with Docker containerization and contributing to Kubernetes orchestration.
* CI/CD Pipelines: Proven exposure to and experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) systems (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines) for automated deployment.
* Testing & TDD: Proficiency in automated testing frameworks (Pytest, unittest) and Test-Driven Development (TDD) methodologies.
* Security: Solid understanding of secure coding practices and application of security principles (OWASP Top 10).
* Version Control: Expertise in Git (Bitbucket, GitHub) for advanced branching, merging, and pull request workflows.

III. Quantitative & Risk Domain
  
  

* Quantitative Computation: Multiple years of experience developing quantitative/calc-intensive Python solutions with advanced computation libraries (e.g., NumPy, Pandas, SciPy).
* Risk Methodologies: Sound understanding of and exposure to various Risk Methodologies (e.g., Market Risk, Stress Testing, Value at Risk (VaR), Sensitivities).
* Domain Delivery: Proven track record of delivering Stress Testing and Regulatory Risk projects in the Market Risk domain.
* Mathematical Modeling: Exposure to mathematical modeling and financial insights.

IV. Artificial Intelligence (AI) Integration (Exposure)
  
  

* AI/ML Frameworks: Exposure to AI/ML tools and frameworks.
* Development Workflows: Practical experience utilizing AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Devin, Claude, Gemini, GPT) to optimize development workflows.
* Agentic AI: Experience with Agentic AI tools, including writing Agents and Skills, and contributing to Agentic frameworks.
* Generative AI: Understanding and practical application of Generative AI concepts in software development.

Professional & Leadership Skills
  
  

* Agile/Scrum: Deep understanding and practical experience working within Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Analytical Thinking: Strong analytical, logical, systems thinking, and critical analysis skills.
* Design Thinking: Demonstrated design thinking skills to solve complex business and technical problems.
* Ownership & Adaptability: Ability to take complete ownership of various parts of a project, adapt to changing priorities, and perform under pressure.

Preferred / "Good to Have" Qualifications
  
  

* Banking Domain: Prior experience working within the banking/financial services domain, specifically in pricing, valuation, or risk management systems.
* Certifications: Relevant Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) or Industry Certifications.
* Financial Certifications: CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) or FRM (Financial Risk Manager) certification is a strong plus.
